messages:
Leah: Heads-up: we need a final pass on landing copy for Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved), and Private (on-prem/VPC) ahead of next week's launch. Goal: concise headlines, 1-line subheads, 3 social hooks, a compact benchmark callout for the blog/press, webinar theme + gating CTA, and a simple lead routing map. Can we ship a first pass today?
Ravi: I can take Hosted + blog benchmark blurb. Will do two headline variants and 1 sentence subheads.
Sam: Ill own Dedicated + CTAs. Priya take Private?
Priya: Yep, Im on Private. Will emphasize security + auditability.
Nina: I'll draft social copy and the three-email webinar cadence. Also prefer CTA button tests: "Get started instantly" vs "Request capacity quote"
Leah: Good. Keep social snappy and engineer-focused. Avoid hype words. Benchmarks must be reproducible with a repo link.
Ravi: Hosted headline A: "Hosted inference that composes with your app 1ms median latency"
Ravi: Hosted headline B: "Scale quickly with a low-friction Hosted API"
Ravi: Hosted subhead: "Streaming, built-in batching, and transparent cost insights."
Sam: Dedicated headline A: "Reserved GPU capacity for mission-critical throughput"
Sam: Dedicated headline B: "Predictable LLM performance with committed pools"
Sam: Dedicated subhead: "Autoscale policies, burst capacity, SLA-backed latency targets."
Priya: Private headline A: "Run inference on your network 100% data control"
Priya: Private headline B: "Private deployments: audited, compliant, and isolated"
Priya: Private subhead: "Bring-your-own-network with KMS integration and audit trail."
Nina: Social hooks (short):
- "Launching next week: how teams get low-latency LLMs without the ops overhead. Register. \ud83d\udcbb"
- "Benchmark preview: same model, 35% lower GPU cost with batching + caching. Read the blog. \ud83d\udcca"
- "Live demo: routing, fallback, and reserved capacity in action. Seats limited. \ud83d\udcdf"
Ravi: Blog benchmark blurb (short): "In our internal chat benchmark (1M messages, mixed-length), Redwood reduced median latency by 25% and 95th percentile latency by 50% vs a baseline multi-tenant endpoint, while lowering GPU cost per 1M tokens by ~35% through workload-aware batching and KV caching. Repro steps and scripts: github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks."
Leah: Nice. Add a one-line note on dataset + seed so press can reproduce.
Sam: CTA mapping suggestions:
- Hosted page: primary CTA = "Get API key" -> funnel = self-serve growth queue
- Dedicated page: primary CTA = "Reserve capacity" -> funnel = sales-enterprise
- Private page: primary CTA = "Request private demo" -> funnel = solutions-eng/security
Sam: Also test secondary CTA on Dedicated: "Estimate monthly cost" (captures committed intent).
Priya: Lead signal mapping (proposal):
```
signal -> page -> priority -> owner-queue
api-key-click -> hosted -> P3 -> growth-sdr
post-deploy-usage>50k -> hosted -> P2 -> enterprise-sdr
reserve-form -> dedicated -> P1 -> sales-enterprise
private-contact -> private -> P1 -> solutions-eng
webinar-reg -> webinar-llm-prod -> P2 -> nurture-team
```
Nina: Add company-size and region headers to routing logic. Also auto-tag leads from webinar with +1 intent score. marketing-bot can append tag.
marketing-bot: Webinar created: "Serving LLMs in production" on 2026-05-04 16:00 UTC. Registration slug: /events/serving-llms-2026. (automated)
Leah: Webinar theme: "Serving LLMs in production: balancing latency, cost, and controls". Gating CTA: register -> tag -> webinar-llm-prod. Follow-up drip: 3 emails (prep, reminder, replay).
Ravi: A/B tests: headline swap + CTA color test. Goal: headline CTR +10% before locking. Sam: Ill wire event to SFDC/Hub and add mapping for lead owner.
Priya: Ill draft the Private page security paragraph and drop into /marketing/content/landing-v2.md by EOD.
Nina: Social calendar: teaser (D-7), benchmark highlight (D-3), last call (D-1), launch announcement (D0). Will tag growth for paid amplification.
Leah: Timeline: first pass copy in this thread by EOD; final reviews tomorrow morning; webinar live in 24h; blog + benchmark publish aligned with webinar. Owners: Hosted (Ravi), Dedicated (Sam), Private (Priya), Social + emails (Nina), Lead routing (Leah + Sam).
Sam: I'll add dedicated page wireframe notes in /marketing/design/ and assign dev tickets.
Leah: Great. If no objections, locking owners and plan. Thanks everyone.
calendar-bot: Event "Serving LLMs in production" added and invites sent to [marketing, growth].
